newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Afghan rebels say Kabul air base captured.
newsitem.headline: Afghan rebels say Kabul air base captured.

text.p: Afghanistan's rebel Taleban Islamic miliitia captured an air base in the capital Kabul on Thursday night, a Taleban spokesman in Pakistan said.
A Taleban spokesman, Mullah Abdul Qadeer, quoted by a Pakistan-based Afghan news service, said Taleban forces had also taken the Soviet-built Microrayon housing complex in eastern Kabul.
There was no immediate independent confirmation of the report.
Witnesses in Kabul said earlier Afghan government troops appeared to be abandoning the capital, which Taleban forces sought to take.
